statement: Education must prepare pupils for environmental challenges
Sustainability concerns environment, society and economy equally
Social justice is an integral part of sustainability
Pupils should think critically, even if it causes disagreement
I encourage all pupils to voice opinions, even dissenting ones
I ensure pupils from other backgrounds participate equally
I respect and draw on diversity in my teaching
I handle conflict through dialogue, not sanctions
Pupils take part in setting classroom rules
I let pupils choose topics or activities
I encourage pupils to propose solutions to environmental problems
I discuss consumption, fair trade or social justice with pupils
I use cooperative learning for sustainability topics
I use real sustainability problems as a starting point
I integrate sustainability across different subjects
I run projects on environmental issues
I work with organisations outside the school
